mil7.4.4:1.1: Bhante Nāgasena, vāyussa pañca angāni gahetabbānīti yaṃ vadesi, katamāni tāni pañca angāni gahetabbānīti. -
mil7.4.4:1.3: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena vimutti-varakusuma-pupphitārammaṇa-vanantare ramitabbaṃ.
mil7.4.4:1.4: Idaṃ mahārāja vāyussa paṭhamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.4:2.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja vāyu dharaṇīruha-pādapa-gaṇe mathayati,
mil7.4.4:2.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena vanantaragatena sankhāre vicinantena kilesā mathayitabbā.
mil7.4.4:2.3: Idaṃ mahārāja vāyussa dutiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.4:3.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja vāyu ākāse carati,
mil7.4.4:3.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena lokuttaradhammesu mānasaṃ sañcārayitabbaṃ.
mil7.4.4:3.3: Idaṃ mahārāja vāyussa tatiyaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.4:4.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja vāyu gandham-anubhavati,
mil7.4.4:4.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena attano sīla-surabhigandho anubhavitabbo.
mil7.4.4:4.3: Idaṃ mahārāja vāyussa catutthaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.4:5.1: Puna ca paraṃ mahārāja vāyu nirālayo aniketavāsī,
mil7.4.4:5.2: evam-eva kho mahārāja yoginā yogāvacarena nirālaya-m-aniketa-m-asanthavena sabbattha vimuttena bhavitabbaṃ.
mil7.4.4:5.3: Idaṃ mahārāja vāyussa pañcamaṃ angaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
mil7.4.4:5.4: Bhāsitam-p' etaṃ mahārāja Bhagavatā devātidevena Suttanipāte:
